claims.text: Labels: guanfacine ER (Intuniv): ADHD, as monotherapy or adjunct to stimulants;
claims.quote: INTUNIV ® is indicated for the treatment of Attention Deficit Hyperactivity Disorder (ADHD) as monotherapy and as adjunctive therapy to stimulant medications

claims.text: clonidine ER: ADHD safety and efficacy established in pts 6–17 y.
claims.quote: The safety and efficacy of clonidine hydrochloride extended-release tablets in the treatment of ADHD have been established in pediatric patients 6 to 17 years of age.

claims.text: Guanfacine ER rebound HTN: abrupt stop → clinically significant, persistent rebound HTN (hypertensive encephalopathy reported); taper ≤ 1 mg every 3–7 days;
claims.quote: Rebound Hypertension: Abrupt discontinuation of INTUNIV can lead to clinically significant and persistent rebound hypertension. Subsequent hypertensive encephalopathy was also reported. To minimize the risk of rebound hypertension upon discontinuation, the total daily dose of INTUNIV should be tapered in decrements of no more than 1 mg every 3 to 7 days

claims.text: children who vomit and miss doses may be esp at risk.
claims.quote: Children commonly have gastrointestinal illnesses that lead to vomiting, and a resulting inability to take medications, so they may be especially at risk for rebound hypertension.
